GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 091.4 (22 Feb 46) CS
(SCAPIN - 761)
APO 500
22 February 1946
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Relief for the Japanese Nationals in Manchuria.
1． Reference is made to CLO Memorandum No.194 (5.2), dated 14 January 1946, subject: "Relief for the Japanese Nationals in Manshuria" requesting a loan of 350,000,000 Manchurian yuan for the living expenses of Japanese Nationals in Manchuria.
2． Your request for assistance in obtaining relief for Japanese nationals in Manchuria is being taken up on a government level and you will be advised as soon as a decision is reached.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
B. M. FITCH
Brigadier General, AGD
Adjutant General
